t: Augustus created the province from western Hispania Ulterior, with its capital at the veteran colony of Emerita Augusta.
Farming, mining and fish-salting made it prosperous, and its monuments at Mérida and Alcántara still stand.
The Alans and then the Suebi ended Roman rule by 439, but its name survives as a classical name for Portugal.
dyk: Roman writers repeated a legend that Lusitanian mares could conceive from the west wind, which was said to explain the great speed of their foals.
ev: The Lusitanian leader Viriathus is murdered, ending the Lusitanian War
Augustus begins the division of Hispania Ulterior
Emerita Augusta is founded for veterans of the Cantabrian Wars
Otho begins a decade as governor of Lusitania
The bridge at Alcántara is built over the Tagus
The Alans receive Lusitania in the division of Hispania
The Suebic king Rechila takes Emerita

f.successor: Kingdom of the Suebi; later the Visigothic Kingdom
